entities.summary: Christopher James Goulding is an Australian professional basketball player for Melbourne United of the National Basketball League (NBL). He made his debut in the NBL in 2006 as a development player with the Brisbane Bullets, going on to play for the Perth Wildcats and Gold Coast Blaze, before settling in Melbourne. In the NBL, Goulding is a three-time championship winner and a three-time All-NBL First Team honouree. He also won the league's scoring title in 2014 and claimed grand final MVP honours in 2018. Goulding is a regular with the Australian Boomers, but he also holds a British passport.
